Home Network Security Checklist 2026
Most households now run a dozen connected devices, from phones to smart plugs. This
guide helps you review each one and close the gaps attackers use first. Not every item
will apply to every home.
The list draws on figures compiled from the annual Network Threat Report and the
advisories published by router vendors during the past year.

1. Change the default router password.
2. Turn on automatic firmware updates.
